summary: A chat message carries the view context of the moment the user sends it, also while it waits in the queue. The browser side is unreleased, so no released behaviour changes; with nothing registered everything is sent as before.
howTo: No code change: an app on the bundled transport (VercelAiChat, useVercelAiChatTransport, <glirastes-chat>) that registers its view as before, also with an own composer that sends through send, submit, submitWithResult or ChatStarters and with the queue on, only bumps the version. What changes: a queued message carries the view of the moment it was queued, and one restored after a reload goes without view context. AiChatProvider freezes a cleaned copy (currentViewContext()) when the user sends a message, at once or into the queue; the transport sends that copy as glirastesViewContext: { version: 1, current } and no longer reads the registry when it sends. A message sent with nothing registered goes without the field even if a view registered before it left the queue. An edit of a queued message keeps the view context of the moment it was queued (to send it about the view open now, remove it and send again). The copy stays in memory (QueuedMessage.viewContext, in onQueueChange and queue.items): queue.storage never gets it and a restored queued message goes without one. Starters, follow-up and clarification chips and direct / commands freeze it when sent; a command form, also of a queued command, and an entity action when submitted or clicked; the continue message after a cut-off answer at the click. A transport of your own gets the copy as an optional viewContext field in the one argument of sendMessage({ text, files?, viewContext? }), only when one was frozen (with nothing registered the argument is exactly as before); put it into your body as glirastesViewContext: { version: 1, current: viewContext }, or ignore it. A wrapper passes the message object on as it came. Calling the transport's sendMessage without AiChatProvider sends a view context only when you pass one. See docs/chat-interactions.md, When the view context is frozen.
